DevicePair.description: Re-pair discovery to the existing device.
DevicePair.title: DevicePair

DeviceParameterChange.description:
A device reported that one of its parameters changed to a new value.

Mirrors :class:`DeviceCommand`'s shape (``device_id``, ``parameter_id``, ``value``) but
flows the other direction — device → Hub.
DeviceParameterChange.title: DeviceParameterChange

Notification.description:
A general user-facing message an integration surfaces to the user as a floating tile in the
app. Distinct from ``controller_did_encounter_error`` (which is specifically for integration
failures/health) — use this for anything informational or advisory the user should see.

``ttl`` is how many seconds the tile stays before auto-dismissing; ``None`` keeps it until the
user dismisses it.
Notification.title: Notification

NotificationPriority.description: How insistently the notification is delivered (maps to the OS interruption levels).
NotificationPriority.title: NotificationPriority

NotificationType.description: The callout style the app renders the notification with.
NotificationType.title: NotificationType

ParameterState.description:
A parameter plus its current ``value`` (same type ``V`` as the parameter's labels/default).

Values are pythonic and serialize natively (Pydantic handles JSON — a ``set`` default_value
becomes an array, etc.). The Hub persists them as JSON; integrations set ``value`` directly.
ParameterState.title: ParameterState

ProvidedCredentials.description:
What a pairing request actually supplies — paired with its type, so pairing can
validate it against Discovery.expected_credentials_options instead of trusting
whatever the integration guessed at discovery time.
ProvidedCredentials.title: ProvidedCredentials

post.description:
Temporarily enables protocol-level discovery mechanisms that are not continuously active. Used to trigger short-lived scan/inquiry modes for transports that require explicit activation
(e.g. Zigbee permit-join style discovery, BLE scan bursts, proprietary radios).

delete.description: Soft - keep device in database to skip setup after re-pairing.

get.description:
A user-facing integration problem. `message` is plain language for display (with any
call-to-action folded into the text); `still_running=False` means the integration failed and
is now inactive. Device-scoped problems travel on the device's `last_error` instead.
